item.tib: rig 'dzin gsang ba'i dbang gi go rim khrigs su sdebs pa bde chen snying po
item.coloph: ces pa sku gsum dgongs pa 'dus pa rig 'dzin gsang ba mthar thug gi dbang khrid go rim bde chen snying po 'di yang sngon dus gter byon du bzhugs pa lding por song bas dngos su ma 'byor ba'i stabs/ grub pa'i skyes chen zab don la dga' ba 'ga' yis yang yang bskul ba dang khyad par du dus 'dir 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba rnal 'byor chen po yar me nyi ma rgyal mtshan gyis ched du bskul ba la brten rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis sngar gnas rjes dran gyi rigs sad pa'i tshig gis kha bkang ste thugs spral ri bo chen po'i mdun zhol stag rtse yang dben du sbyar zhing yi ge pa ni nye gnas a yu rdor rdzas bgyis pas bstan 'gro smin cing grol ba'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
